title: Night call on the keypad menu
proves: The module works with no operator and a basic phone: keypad answers plus a short spoken answer after the beep.
summary: A late-night caller uses the keypad menu: safe right now, nobody nearby, no thoughts of ending life, but low mood and worry on most days. After the beep she says a few words about not sleeping and worrying for her children.

steps.text: रात को नींद नहीं आती। मन भारी रहता है और बच्चों की चिंता लगी रहती है।
steps.gloss: I cannot sleep at night. My heart feels heavy and I keep worrying about the children.
